bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities, establishing governance guardrails for enterprise cloud/data platform modernization.
Re-architected insurer underwriting and core operational systems for high availability and real-time processing, delivering resilient reference architecture across business-critical workflows.
Built an AWS shared-responsibility operating model defining insurer-owned versus cloud-provider controls, providing delivery governance clarity for portfolio-wide regulated cloud adoption.
